instruction.description: Insert into #__jed_extensions. JED3 modelled "free" and "paid" as two variants of one master extension (see the now-removed free/paid attach and master_row instructions); the current schema has no variant concept, so every JED3 extension row (combine_jed_extensions has one row per original wqyh6_jed_extensions.id) becomes its own #__jed_extensions row instead of being merged into a master row. homepage_link has no exact equivalent and is mapped to developer_url; extension_file and second_contact_email are mapped to internal_download_url and developer_email as the closest available columns. license_link, tags, language_code, includes, community_choice, download_integration_type/url, currency, price*, language_body, backlink, non_gpl_css_js, parent_id, jed_checked, extension_ext_libs, update_url_ok and can_update have no equivalent column in the new schema and are not migrated.
instruction.sql: INSERT INTO #__jed_extensions ( id, name, alias, catid, owner, state, approved, approved_time, description, license, requires_registration, type, created, created_by, modified, modified_by, checked_out, checked_out_time, extension_version, joomla_versions, download_url, support_url, demo_url, documentation_url, internal_download_url, uses_updater, update_url, developer_url, developer_email, score_overall, score_functionality, score_ease_of_use, score_support, score_documentation, score_value_for_money, score_count, popular, logo, video, internal_note ) SELECT id, core_title, core_alias, core_catid, core_created_user_id, core_state, approved, approved_time, core_body, license, requires_registration, type, core_created_time, core_created_user_id, core_modified_time, core_modified_user_id, core_checked_out_user_id, core_checked_out_time, version, versions, download_link, support_link, demo_link, documentation_link, extension_file, uses_updater, update_url, homepage_link, second_contact_email, score, functionality, ease_of_use, support, documentation, value_for_money, num_reviews, popular, logo, video, jed_note FROM combine_jed_extensions

instruction.sql: CREATE TABLE combine_jed_reviews AS SELECT ucm.*,jr.* FROM wqyh6_ucm_content ucm, wqyh6_jed_reviews jr WHERE core_type_alias="com_jed.review" AND jr.id = core_content_item_id

instruction.description: Copying reviews to #__jed_reviews. Each JED3 free/paid variant is now its own #__jed_extensions row (see the "Porting Extensions Data" task), so reviews are matched directly on the original extension id instead of being split into a free pass and a paid pass; #__jed_reviews also no longer has a supply_option_id column.
instruction.sql: INSERT INTO #__jed_reviews ( id, extension_id, title, alias, body, functionality, functionality_comment, ease_of_use, ease_of_use_comment, support, support_comment, documentation, documentation_comment, value_for_money, value_for_money_comment, overall_score, used_for, version,flagged, ip_address, state, created_on, created_by, ordering) SELECT 0, cj.id, cr.core_title, cr.core_alias, cr.core_body, cr.functionality, '', cr.ease_of_use, '', cr.support, '', cr.documentation, '', cr.value_for_money, '', ( cr.functionality+ cr.ease_of_use + cr.support + cr.documentation + cr.value_for_money) AS 'overall_score', used_for, cr.version, flagged,ip_address, cr.core_state, cr.core_created_time, cr.core_created_user_id, 0 FROM combine_jed_reviews cr, combine_jed_extensions cj WHERE cr.extension_id = cj.id ORDER BY cj.id, cr.core_created_time ASC

instruction.description: Copying the old per-extension aggregate scores (wqyh6_jed_extensions.functionality/ease_of_use/support/documentation/value_for_money/score) into #__jed_reviews as a synthetic review row, since #__jed_extension_scores no longer exists and the current schema has no separate scores table. Only extensions that actually had reviews in JED3 (num_reviews > 0) get one of these rows.
instruction.sql: INSERT INTO #__jed_reviews ( id, extension_id, title, alias, body, functionality, ease_of_use, support, documentation, value_for_money, overall_score, state, created_on, created_by, ordering ) SELECT 0, id, 'Migrated JED3 extension score', '', '', functionality, ease_of_use, support, documentation, value_for_money, score, core_state, core_created_time, core_created_user_id, 0 FROM combine_jed_extensions WHERE num_reviews > 0
